provenance.method: Independent calculation from inspected source parameters and D65 CIELAB conversion; repository code was not executed

generation.colorSpace: CIE LCh(ab), D65 whitepoint (not CSS lch D50 or OKLCH)
generation.conversion: LCh to Lab to D65 XYZ to sRGB, clip channels to [0,1], round to nearest 8-bit value
generation.note: The source names luma, but the quantity is CIE Lab L*, not relative luminance. Grade direction is reversed for light variants; absGrade(g) returns 10-g there.
